name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-05-05, at wavelengths from 0.79 to 4.11 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
